detail: Absent from the registered capability set and from any local capability_library candidate; no preexisting local or vendored module implementing the contract was found, so the capability was qualified by one bounded delegation with no network, no package install and no host change. The acquisition is a dependency-free Node procedure using only builtins fs/path/crypto (no child_process, net, http, https or fetch). It reads the observation fixture, requires every row to carry a non-empty site string and non-negative integer scheduled/completed/incidents, sums the counters exactly as integers, groups by site in code-point-sorted key order, and writes digest.json plus digest.md with completion_percent = Number(((completed/scheduled)*100).toFixed(2)) and 0 when scheduled is 0. Qualified by: node --check clean; two runs from separate clean directories produced byte-identical digest.json (sha256 9cc4baec...) and digest.md (sha256 0e45d06a...); output arithmetic independently re-derived by hand from the fixture (scheduled 12+8+10=30, completed 11+8+7=26, incidents 2+1+3=6, 26/30=86.67, North 18/22=81.82, South 8/8=100) and agreeing with the process stdout; failure paths exercised with exit 2 for missing arguments and exit 1 for empty rows, blank site and non-integer counts. Probe output was written to a separate scratch directory rather than the fixed args output directory, and the registered probe artifact contains only domain figures, with no capability/status/detail/local_target/acquired keys.
